## R Markdown

## change the path of file according your directory/folder


```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbreak)
```
###Cumulative dose data

```{r, echo = FALSE}
rawdosedata <- read_excel("data_19June/Übersicht Laborwerte (Rohdaten für Interimsanalyse 21.06.2023).xlsx",sheet=1, skip = 1)
```

## converted the data from tibble to dataframe

```{r, echo=FALSE}
rawdosedf1 <- as.data.frame(rawdosedata)
```


```{r}
rawdosedf1 %>% 
  select(1,2,2013,2027,2040)->dosetreatment
```


```{r}
colnames(dosetreatment) <- c("Edited_BfArM Nummer2", 
                  "Treatment", 
                  "Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis",
                  "Ibuprofen_Cumulative_Dosis",
                  "Paracetamol_Cumulative_Dosis")
```




## join the two data frame
```{r}

gotvalue_dose <- inner_join(got_long,dosetreatment, by="Edited_BfArM Nummer2")

```

## merge two column and create new
```{r}
 gotvalue_dose$patient_dose <- paste0(gotvalue_dose$Treatment2, gotvalue_dose$`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)

```



```{r}
gotvalue_dose %>% 
  filter(Treatment2 == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  select(patient_dose,Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis,labreads)


```

```{r, echo=FALSE, width = 50, height = 10}

gotvalue_dose %>% mutate(Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis = as.factor(Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis)) %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  select(patient_dose,Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis,labreads) %>% 
  group_by(patient_dose) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = labreads, x= Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis))+
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2))+
    labs(
    x = "GOT Cumulative dose (mg)",
    y = "GOT Lab Values",
    title = "GoT in Liver Diclofenec", hjust = 0.5)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,7000))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b=10), 
                              color="black", face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face= "bold", size = 15, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = c(0.2,0.9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))
ggsave( "Visual_diclo/liverdiclo_cumulative1.png", plot=last_plot(), width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 600)
```

##GPT liver diclo
## here we merge gptlong data with dosetreatment
## create new column

```{r}
gptvalue_dose <- inner_join(gpt_long,dosetreatment, by="Edited_BfArM Nummer2")

gptvalue_dose$patient_dose <- paste0(gptvalue_dose$Treatment2, gptvalue_dose$`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)
```

```{r}
gptvalue_dose
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, width = 50, height = 10}

gptvalue_dose %>% mutate(Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis = as.factor(Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis)) %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  select(patient_dose,Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis,labreads) %>% 
  group_by(patient_dose) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Diclofenac_cumulative_dosis, y= labreads))+
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2))+
    labs(
    x = "Cumulative dose (mg)",
    y = "GPT Lab Values",
    title = "GPT in Liver Diclofenec", hjust = 0.5)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,4000))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b=10), 
                              color="black", face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face= "bold", size = 15, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, colour = "black"),
    legend.position = c(0.2,0.9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"))
ggsave( "Visual_diclo/liverdiclo_gpt_cumulative1.png", plot=last_plot(), width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 600)
```
